description: Negative: daily sleep snapshot with a sleepQuality rating outside the four defined individuals
shaclConstraintViolated: health:DailySleepSnapshotShape constrains health:sleepQuality with sh:in (health:Excellent health:Good health:Fair health:Poor). health:Restless is not one of them.
notes: A vendor-specific quality label leaking through an importer is the realistic source of an out-of-vocabulary value here. Without the sh:in it would be stored and later compared against the four defined ratings as if it were one of them.
